faq.title: What exporters ask before starting
faq.q1: Do I have to replace my ERP?
faq.a1: No. Agora works alongside email, Excel and your ERP. You start by sending documents, and integrations come later only if you need them.
faq.q2: Can Agora send the documents to my buyer and forwarder?
faq.a2: Yes. Each document set in your process names the parties it goes to: buyer, consignee, notify party, forwarder, shipping line or customs agent. When its documents are approved, you send it from the shipment and each party gets one email with the PDFs. Replies go to your team.
faq.a3: You see a demo on your own documents in 48 hours. First shipments usually run in Agora within a few weeks.
faq.a4: Each company's data is isolated and encrypted, with a full audit trail. It is never sold and is shared only with the providers needed to run the service.
faq.q5: What language does it work in?
faq.a5: The platform is in Spanish. It reads and generates English export documents: BLs, invoices, certificates and carrier correspondence.

process.title: Your export process,
process.lede: You model the process once. From then on every contract and shipment follows it: Agora reads the documents that arrive, generates the ones you issue and sends each set to the parties that need it.
process.step1Body: Phases, the documents in each one and the order between them. For each document you choose whether Agora reads it from a file, generates it from data, or bundles it into a set for a party.
process.step1Caption: Garlic export: 3 phases, 6 documents, one commercial set.
process.step1Alt: Agora's process editor for a garlic export: phase 1 shipping instruction; phase 2 export invoice (generated) and packing list; phase 3 bill of lading, phytosanitary certificate and a commercial document set, joined by their dependencies.
process.step2Body: Each shipment of a contract gets the process with its own documents. Your team sees what's approved, what's pending and what each document unlocks next.
process.step2Caption: Invoice and packing list approved; the commercial set is ready to send.
process.step2Alt: The process of one shipment in Agora: shipping instruction, export invoice and packing list approved; bill of lading and phytosanitary certificate pending; the commercial set approved and ready to download or email.
process.step3Title: Agora reads the documents that arrive
process.step3Body: Upload a booking confirmation, a shipping instruction or a certificate. Agora extracts its data, links the shipping line and the forwarder to your accounts, and shows it next to the original for approval. Values that don't match the contract or the booking wait for a person to decide.
process.step3Caption: Booking confirmation read from its PDF.
process.step3Alt: Review of a Maersk booking confirmation in Agora: the extracted data on the left, with the shipping line and forwarder linked to accounts, and the original PDF on the right.
process.step4Title: Agora generates the documents you issue
process.step4Body: The commercial invoice is built from data you already have: the contract, the booking and your company record, in your own template. You add what's missing and approve it.
process.step4Caption: Commercial invoice EXP-2611-0042, generated from shipment data.
process.step4Alt: An export invoice generated by Agora: document data on the left and the generated commercial invoice in English on the right, with products, net weight, price per kg and total.
process.step5Title: Send each set to the parties
process.step5Body: When its documents are approved, the set goes out by email to the buyer, the forwarder, the shipping line or the customs agent, one email per party with the approved PDFs attached. Replies go to your team's inbox.
process.step5Caption: Invoice and packing list, to the buyer and the forwarder.
process.step5Alt: Sharing a document set in Agora: an email to the buyer and the forwarder for shipment 2611202-2, with the export invoice and packing list attached as PDFs.
